usedFor: Flodesk collects subscribers, and Sangam CRM receives them as leads when “New Subscriber Created” runs “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Subscriber Created” in Flodesk, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Matching by email or phone lets an existing lead be updated instead of added again.

watchOut: “New Subscriber Created” covers only new subscribers, so people already on your list will not reach Sangam CRM.
